widgets_values: Style: Chinese ink-wash illustration with classical literati aesthetics, warm rice-paper texture, soft sepia-gray palette, and fine calligraphic detail. The composition presents a graceful young East Asian woman as the central figure in a refined traditional interior, surrounded by bamboo, rocks, flowers, misty mountains, tea objects, and poetic inscriptions. The upper-left area contains a vertical calligraphic title in bold black brushwork reading "浮生若梦", with smaller adjacent vertical columns reading "一枕黄粱" and "半世浮萍". Beneath these inscriptions is a small red square seal with stylized carved characters, visually integrated into the parchment-like background. Across the upper-right margin, another vertical inscription reads "庚子春月写于江南烟雨楼", accompanied by a small red seal below it. The right side features tall bamboo stalks and narrow leaves painted in layered gray-black ink, with splashes and dry-brush textures that overlap the pale landscape behind them. In the middle-right background, faint mountains, water, trees, and a pavilion appear through mist, rendered with diluted washes and soft atmospheric perspective. The lower-right foreground holds a dark irregular rock, white blossoms with yellow centers, green-gray leaves, and a small tea vessel near the edge of the table. The central woman is shown from about the waist up, seated at a wooden table, with fair skin, delicate facial features, downcast eyes, soft brows, subtle eyeliner, light blush, and muted red lips. Her expression is calm and introspective. She has long black hair arranged in an elaborate half-up traditional style, decorated with floral hairpins, dangling ornaments, and small beads. She wears a flowing pale hanfu-style robe with translucent layered sleeves, embroidered floral details, and soft gray-beige shading. Her right hand supports her cheek, while her left hand holds a slender writing brush over an open book or scroll on the table. The lower-left foreground includes a bronze or dark ceramic incense burner with perforated lid and rounded form, placed on a dark wooden surface. Around it are loose ink splatters, plant stems, pale blossoms, and scattered leaves. Behind the woman, the interior includes wooden lattice windows, hanging scrolls, soft drapery, and blurred garden scenery outside. The overall image uses traditional ink diffusion, paper grain, gentle contrast, and poetic negative space to create a quiet Jiangnan spring atmosphere.
